content.title: Content
content.intro: Your Instagram posts and stories: drafts, scheduled and published.

empty.hint: The posts and stories you prepare are listed here by their status.

content.notFound: This content could not be found.

generation.slow: This is taking longer than expected. You can also write the text yourself instead of waiting.
generation.failed: The draft could not be prepared automatically. You can write the text yourself.
generation.hint: The text appears by itself when it is ready. What you type meanwhile is kept.

editor.overlayNote: On a story the text has to be on the image: these suggestions are for you to put on the picture, they are not published separately.
editor.conflict: Someone else changed this while you were editing. The latest version has been loaded; what you typed is still there, review it and save again.
editor.editVoidsApproval: This content was sent for approval or scheduled. If you edit it, the approval is voided and it goes back to a draft.
editor.readOnly: This content can no longer be changed.

issues.label: Text check
issues.blockingHint: These must be fixed before it can be sent for publishing.
issues.blocking: “{{text}}” is not a verified fact. Correct the value or verify it in your business information.
issues.PLACEHOLDER_UNRENDERED: The placeholder “{{text}}” could not be filled in. Replace it with a verified fact or delete it.
issues.CLAIM_UNBACKED: The claim “{{text}}” is not backed by a verified fact. Remove it or verify the information.
issues.stale: A fact changed since this was checked. The text is checked again when you save.

checks.MEDIA_NOT_READY: The image is not ready yet.
checks.CAPTION_TOO_LONG: The caption is too long ({{length}} / {{max}} characters).
checks.CAPTION_NOT_ALLOWED: A story has no caption. Put the text on the image.
checks.ASPECT_RATIO_OUT_OF_RANGE: The image ratio does not suit a post (it must be between 4:5 and 1.91:1).
checks.CLAIM_VALIDATION_FAILED: The text contains information that is not verified.
checks.ACCOUNT_NOT_CONNECTED: There is no connected Instagram account.
checks.CAPABILITY_MISSING: The connected account cannot publish this kind of content.
checks.STORY_ASPECT_NOT_9_16: The image is not 9:16 ({{width}}×{{height}}). It may be cropped or leave gaps at the edges on a story.
checks.OVERLAY_TOO_LONG: This suggestion is long: up to 3 lines of 40 characters stay readable.
checks.SCHEDULE_IN_PAST: The chosen time has already passed. Pick a later time.
checks.SCHEDULE_TOO_FAR: A post can be scheduled at most 60 days ahead.
checks.SCHEDULE_TIME_NONEXISTENT: There is no {{local_time}} on {{local_date}} in {{timezoneLabel}} (the clocks skip that hour). Choose another time.
checks.SCHEDULE_TOO_SOON_FOR_APPROVAL: Someone has to approve this before it is published. Choose a time at least {{minutes}} minutes from now.
checks.PUBLISH_QUOTA_FORECAST_EXCEEDED: Too many posts are already scheduled around this time. Choose another time.

media.label: Image
media.feedHint: Add a portrait or square image for the post (between 4:5 and 1.91:1).
media.storyHint: Add a 9:16 image for the story. On Instagram the story text has to be on the image.
media.previewFailed: The image could not be shown.
media.tooLarge: This image is too large (limit {{limit}}). Choose a smaller one.

reason.EMPTY_FILE: The file is empty. Choose another image.
reason.NOT_AN_IMAGE: This file is not a supported image. Upload a JPEG or PNG.
reason.CORRUPT_IMAGE: The image file looks damaged. Choose another image.
reason.TOO_MANY_PIXELS: The image resolution is too high. Choose a smaller image.

actions.cancelAsk: Cancel this item? Its scheduled publication is cancelled too.
actions.waitGeneration: It cannot be scheduled while the text is being prepared.

generate.title: New content
generate.objectiveLabel: What do you want to share?
generate.objectiveHint: E.g. “A story for the trial class”. Prices, hours and similar details come only from your verified information.
generate.accountHint: When you schedule, the content is set up to be published on this account.
generate.accountNone: No Instagram account is connected. You can prepare the draft; connect the account before scheduling.
generate.runningHint: This can take a few seconds. If you would rather not wait, open the draft now and write the text yourself.
generate.slow: It is taking longer than expected. Open the draft and write the text yourself.
generate.failedTitle: The draft could not be prepared automatically.
generate.failedHint: A blank draft was created. You can write the text yourself.
generate.titleHint: A name only you will see. You add the text and the image in the draft.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.timezoneHint: The time you enter is in {{zone}}.
schedule.overlayNote: This text is not published separately with the story; it has to be on the image.
schedule.whenNow: Now: queued for publishing as soon as it is approved
schedule.staffNote: This is published after an owner or manager approves it. If it is not approved by the chosen time it expires and goes back to a draft.
schedule.approverNote: When you approve, the item is scheduled. It reads “Scheduled” until Instagram confirms it was published.
schedule.nowNote: The item is queued for publishing right away. It does not read “Published” until that is confirmed.
schedule.reapproveNote: It is approved again with the text unchanged. Everything is checked again: if the text still has a value that is not verified, such as an old price, edit it first.

approval.heading: What this approval will publish
approval.caption: Caption
approval.overlayNote: Not published separately with a story; it has to be on the image.
approval.stale: This content changed after approval was requested (now version {{current}}, approval covers version {{approved}}). This approval no longer applies; the content has to be sent for approval again.
approval.loadFailed: The content could not be loaded.

detail.pending: Waiting for approval: it is scheduled once an owner or manager approves. If it is not approved by {{time}} it expires and goes back to a draft.
detail.rejectedNext: You can edit it and send it again.

draftHold.FACT_CHANGED: Business information it uses changed, so the item sent for approval was returned to a draft. Review the text and send it again.
draftHold.APPROVAL_EXPIRED: The approval expired, so it went back to a draft. Pick a new time and send it again.

detail.cancelled: This item was cancelled and will not be published.
detail.publishing: Publishing. The status updates when Instagram confirms it.

failure.title: What happened?
failure.retryAt: Will be tried again at {{time}} ({{attempts}} attempts so far)
failure.retryAuto: It is retried automatically; you do not need to do anything.
failure.noRetry: It will not be retried automatically.

unknown.next: Open the post to see the details, then edit or schedule it again.

failure.exhausted: It could not be published after several attempts.

hold.title: On hold

FACT_CHANGED.what: It was put on hold because business information it uses has changed.
FACT_CHANGED.next: Review the text; if it is still right, approve it again as it is, otherwise edit it.

ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE.what: It was put on hold because the Instagram account was not available.
ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE.next: Reconnect the account, then approve it again.

unknown.what: This item was put on hold.
unknown.next: Review the text, then approve it again or edit it.

hold.staffNote: An owner or manager has to approve it again. You can edit the text and send it for approval again.
